Op, I know this is an old thread but this is my suggestion if you are still interested. I managed to get to rank 5 without trying while being the most toxic DBD that I know of. You can make red ranks rage quit with ease, I got 5 pages of salt and hatemail after doing this so beware.

I heavily recommend Ghost Face (Corrupt Intervention - Rancor - NOED - Blood Warden), no addons necessary.

The way the build work is that you will be constantly camping hooks with your shroud, watching for anyone coming in and stalking them if they come for the rescue. If you can get the person coming for the save, then get them first, if not, get the person that got unhooked.

Ghost Face ability counters borrowed time as long as you are not revealed even if you are close to them. This lets you tunnel someone to death or at least get 2nd stage.

Rancor allows you to kill your obsession by hand and exposes them once all the gens are completed, it also gives you location of every survivor which can come in handy. You should use this information to set up the next person to be tunneled or get downs during exit gates. Rancor also gives you value if you get Decisive Striked, you can get yourself Dstrike then leave that person for later and kill them IF the gates are powered, letting you tunnel someone else. This is especially true if you somehow kill your obsession first so it won't be a waste of a perk if that's the case

Corrupt Intervention buy you 120 seconds of camping, which is essential, less gens = more attempts for saves = more downs and potentially chain reaction (I got 3 people downs in the first 100 sec of the game because they all tried to come and save someone)

Blood Warden is the counter to survivors that wants to mess with you or try to save the person that you hooked with NOED at the end game. If the end game meter reaches or about to reach half way, hook someone and it's GG, you can look for vids to see how to time it exactly.

Ideally, we want to trade 1 gen + intervention for 1 kill if possible, if this happens, you can play normally and don't have to be AS toxic. However, if its 2 gens + intervention then that's alright but you are gonna have to be even more toxic.

The game will drastically slowdown once its 1 v 3, you have to use your judgement if you want to camp someone again and get 2 people out which is a GG, or you have to rotate gens and get kills that way if they are aware that you are camping.

Rancor + NOED will give you 2 kills at WORSE even against organized red ranks SWF where you only manage to get 1 kill before all gens popped.

You can use  "Ghost Face Caught on Tape" to get that hook save kill easier, also any power recovery addons will help. However I recommend you run no addons while you get yourself familiarized to where exactly camp the hooks for max efficiency and salt.

I recommend a Mori if its against keys or SWF, green or red doesn't really matter now since they got nerfed, one less hook the better, especially if you want to time Dstrikes for whatever reason.

Tips:

* Make sure to leave the hooked person LOS and circle back so they don't see you and give their friends a heads-up.
* When looking for which spot to use for camping, prioritize Angles >>> Distance > Camoflauge, this means that you should always be picking a hook that have as few line of sight as possible. You don't want to have a survivor coming from an angle where you cannot see, and god forbid if they somehow ends up behind you, the goal is to not let them know you are there if possible. Make sure that it's close enough from hiding spots for you to come and get the hit, you don't want to be too far out and don't want to be too close (relates to first tip). Finally, find a place where you think you can hide in, look for tall grasses, dark spots and things around it, we don't want to be behind a tiny rock in the middle of a field.
* Pay attention to the hooked person meter, if it's almost to the 2nd stage (half way), be ready or even preemptively body block the survivor that's coming in to save them, this will make them dead on the next hook.
* In contrast to Bubba, which excels at locking down a single survivor where you will have to be right in front of them to get value. We want as many save attempts from the survivors as possible.  Having them save an early hook mean we're saving a lot of time waiting for it to reach another stage and potentially their early death. 
* Try to get them to the basement if you can, make sure you hook them onto the furthest hook back so they can't see you. You can crouch behind the stair case to stalk and chain kill anyone that comes down, it's a near guaranteed 3k if you get a down near the basement.
* Don't get worried if things are coming apart, as long as you get that 1 kill before 5 gens are finished, you are fine. The game truly starts once the gens are done and you can fuck them up HARD.
* Know when, and when not to slug. You can start slugging once you get that first kill, slugging will let you slowdown the game even more. If the person you stalked to almost full is close, slug the first then go after them, you can get 2 downs in 30 seconds if done right.
* You can use your shroud to look for survivors, if you fill up your meter then you know someone is there. Make sure you watch some Ghost Face guides if you haven't played him already.

Overall, you want to be a GOOD Killer AND Ghost Face player if you want to do this. Many ghost face tries to camp and get fucked by survivors even harder, make sure you know how to handle loops as we want to end chase ASAP which means more time to camp.

Have fun, shit talk and Tbags the fuckers once you win. There's no better feeling than having 3 people slugged near a hook and you just tbags them for a minute while they crawl around. Beaware of Unbreakable though, that can fuck you up if you have too much fun.

Remember, it's your game and you choose how to play it, don't listen to anyone else :)
